tutorial.dismantle.blocked: Huh? No, no! You can't dismantle that block right now.
tutorial.intro.1: Hi. I'm your instructor again today. You remember me, right?
tutorial.intro.2: Our goal is to protect the Core Block. If the Core Block is destroyed, the entire system will collapse.
tutorial.intro.3: This time, I've prepared two Green Blocks and one Red Block. Let's confirm the deployment list first.
tutorial.first.red.connect: Now, how about connecting the Red Block between the existing Red Blocks?
tutorial.colorblind.question: Wait. Is it difficult to tell red and green apart? You need to select the Red Block right now...
tutorial.colorblind.prompt: We're preparing a Color Vision Support mode for players who have difficulty distinguishing colors.
tutorial.first.red.wrong:
...You made a mistake, right? It's okay. You can dismantle a wrongly placed block with right-click, but you won't be able to place it again, so be careful...
I'll make an exception this time and let you place it again. Try dismantling the block you placed earlier.
tutorial.first.attack.success: Great job! When 3 Red Blocks are connected, they transform into an Attack Block like this!
tutorial.second.green.connect: This time, connect the two Green Blocks to the Green Block above them to create a Recovery Block.
tutorial.second.healer.success: Well done! Shall we start defending now?
tutorial.second.healer.fail: Hmm... That's okay. Delaying the creation of a special block can also be a good strategy depending on the situation! Let's get started.
tutorial.gameover: Oh no... We failed today. It's okay. Let's make it work tomorrow!
tutorial.clear.shockwave: As long as you survive until the Shockwave is fully charged, you can eliminate all enemies at once.
tutorial.clear.killall: Nice! You defeated all the enemies. You can defeat them before that, but if you survive until the Core is charged, you can also eliminate them all at once with the Shockwave.
tutorial.glitch.last: You did great all the way to the end today! To learn this so quickly, you're really amazi...
prologue.objective: If we put her into hibernation inside the Core, we can save her.

analytics.consent.title: Playtest Data Collection
analytics.consent.message:
Would you like to share playtest data to help make KeepCoreSafe more fun and enjoyable?

To improve the game, we collect a randomly generated installation identifier, session and device information, the country/region estimated from your IP address, and gameplay data such as tutorial progress, waves, choices, and failures.

We do not collect your name, email address, chat messages, or precise location. Collected data is processed through GameAnalytics and used for game improvement and playtest analysis.

Sharing this data is optional, and you can play the game without agreeing. You can change this setting at any time in the Settings menu. If you are a minor, please talk to a parent or guardian before agreeing.
